info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Leucite Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Leucite Drill Details Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information for leucite drill products. This API empowers developers to upload and register new drill specifications, ensuring a comprehensive catalog for manufacturers and distributors. Typical consumers include engineering teams, sales departments, and product managers who require accurate and detailed drill information for customer projects. Enhance your operational efficiency by leveraging this API for streamlined catalog updates and enhanced product visibility.

post.summary: Create new details for leucite drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new detail entries for the leucite drill. Please provide all necessary information in the request body to successfully create the entry.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details about the leucite drill operation. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the defined schema to facilitate accurate processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning relevant details.

CreateCatalogLeuciteDrillDetailRequest.title: Leucite Drill Request Body

leucite_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the leucite drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of leucite drills requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is prioritized.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a single leucite drill.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the leucite drill operation.

items.description: A single tag for categorizing the operation.

CreateCatalogLeuciteDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a leucite drill operation.

CreateCatalogLeuciteDrillDetailResponse_.title: Leucite Drill Operation Post Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the recorded operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The count of records matched during the operation.

warnings.description: A list of warnings that occurred during the operation, if any.
example: Warning: Some records were not processed due to missing fields.

items.description: A single warning message detailing the issue.
